prompt: What most likely caused the problem?
promptZh: 最可能是什麼原因造成這個問題？

options.text: The daytime-mode switch was turned off.
options.zh: 白天模式的開關被關掉了。
options.whyZh: 男方確認開關仍在白天模式。

options.text: The new battery is too weak to move the hands.
options.zh: 新電池太弱，無法帶動指針。
options.whyZh: 沒有電力不足的跡象；換電池後只調了指針。

options.text: The back dial was left twelve hours off.
options.zh: 背面的轉盤設定差了十二小時。
options.whyZh: 轉盤用來區分上午和下午；換電池後沒把它調對，才會在夜間響。

options.text: The clock was moved into the hall.
options.whyZh: 走廊是鐘所在的位置，不是報時設定異常的原因。

explanationZh: 轉盤用來區分上午和下午；換電池後沒把它調對，才會在夜間響。
evidence: The switch is still on daytime mode. I changed the battery yesterday, and I only set the hands. The little dial at the back tells it whether it’s morning or evening. I must have left that twelve hours off.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The switch is still on daytime mode. I changed the battery yesterday, and I only set the hands. The little dial at the back tells it whether it’s morning or evening. I must have left that twelve hours off.

vocabulary.note: off 在此指設定有偏差；這會顛倒上午與下午。
